stemMarkdown: A boat covers 84 km downstream in 3.5000 hours and the same 84 km upstream in 5.2500 hours. Find the speed of the stream (in km/h). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed $= \dfrac{84}{3.5000} = 24.0000$ km/h and upstream speed $= \dfrac{84}{5.2500} = 16.0000$ km/h. The stream speed is half their difference: $4$ km/h.
